A '''Jedi artisan''' was a specialization that could be attained by those [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] studying the ways of the [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]], who tried to understand creativity as a central aspect of the will of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Overview==
[[File:Mystic-artist_UP.png|thumb|left|250px|A Jedi artisan using the force to create a sculpture.]]
Jedi artisans typically pursued the construction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], although they sometimes focused on other crafts. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] artisans might create a mere half-dozen true master works in their career. Some of these pieces were given to particular Jedi, while others were entrusted to the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="JAPC">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030424artisan|text=Jedi Artisan Prestige Class}}</ref>

Notable Jedi artisans were the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]&ndash;era Master [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|53|Baas, Master Vodo-Siosk}}</ref> and the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Felanil Baaks]] in the years prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He created lightsabers with casings of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], [[Wood/Legends|wood]], and stone, and one unique lightsaber crafted as a liquid matrix suspended in a compressed gravity tube. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was given one of Baaks' [[Coruscani lightsaber|lightsabers]], although he later gave this to a young Jedi from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="Felanil Baaks, Jedi Artisan">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030313baaks|text=Felanil Baaks, Jedi Artisan}}</ref> Baaks himself traveled to the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] system, where he trained five new Jedi artisans. Another artisan, Jedi [[Jwartek]], crafted a hilt out of a branch from an ancient tree, while another specialized in crystal and glass hilts.<ref name="JAPC" />
